blocks.text: More than 2,600 suspects have been repatriated through joint Philippine-Chinese law enforcement efforts since 2023, Beijing said following the deportation of 115 Chinese arrested last month for suspected illegal offshore gaming. In a statement on Saturday, its embassy in Manila said “China appreciates the assistance provided by relevant Philippine law enforcement authorities.” READ: China thanks
